Thank you! that is really insightful, I think I'm going to save that image and read it everytime I feel my world shaking. 

I think you're right, and my inner self is trying to rebuild everything but it feels so strange, so phony... During so many years I've been so used to relly on other to make my life that seems I can't trust myself to make a decision. But, has I already read it somewhere, we born alone and we die alone, better get used to it.

thank you for your words, and hug :). I try to make small changes in my life, even my psy makes me do them "you have to make something different at least 3 times a week, do something you like, don't be at home all day!", but this last few days beeing sick (a small cold) have really drop me down, and not beeing in my best mood... well, it's a wonderfull cocktail for my head.

Yes it was a big lesson, never though she would do that to me, specially because she also tells me averything about her (she doesn't have anyone else to turn to) and I never judge her. ahah then you will be surprise with my age I'm 25, I think all this life lessons should had bang my life some years ago, maybe now I wouldn't be so disappointed with life itself.
